user_outcome: Run all approved development workflow comparisons without a budget ceiling while reducing wall time through safe per-VM parallelism.
boundaries: Use the existing evaluator and preserve its correctness, quality, timing, credit, and immutable-history separation.
Use neutral executable tasks for cross-workflow comparison.
Freeze every treatment, adapter, model, case, image, and evaluator revision.
Treat unavailable human interaction as a compatibility result or a predeclared deterministic checkpoint response.
Keep provider-specific VM provisioning and private fixtures outside the public plugin repository.

existing_capabilities.capability: Frozen plugin snapshots, case revisions, suite attempts, candidate and independent judge sessions.
Editable repository candidates in Docker, exact patch export, fresh offline graders, candidate telemetry capture.
Role-separated session accounting with explicit unknown and partial credit coverage.
Rebuildable local history grouped by exact task, arm, model, harness, image, and evaluation configuration.

external_frozen_inputs.known_boundary: Faithful unattended execution begins from an already approved implementation plan and green isolated branch.
The complete plugin and genuine generic-subagent capability are required; remote shipping stages need bounded fake or private remotes.
TypeScript/npm-only as shipped; Copilot provider substitution and authoritative child-session telemetry join must be disclosed.
TDD requires deterministic seam confirmation; diagnosing-bugs permits a predeclared AFK hypothesis-checkpoint policy.

measured_prior_capacity.observation: Four concurrent hosted jobs were reliable while six concurrent jobs triggered release-asset instability.
measured_prior_capacity.interpretation: Start at four concurrent attempts and raise only after an admission wave proves the current dependencies tolerate it.

failures_to_prevent: Treating a multi-agent orchestrator as a single skill session and undercounting candidate cost.
Comparing development-loop-specific process judgments as though they were neutral correctness.
Changing an upstream workflow to bypass a human gate without recording the adapter.
Running two mutating treatments in one VM or workspace.
Losing partial completed attempts when a VM, network, release asset, or judge fails.
Pooling TypeScript-only Sandcastle results with cross-language treatments as one homogeneous population.
